about_the_game:
Take to the skies in Flycremental, the ultimate incremental sky-runner where your upgrades actually matter. Strap yourself into a rickety, rune-etched sky-cart and blast off, weaving between medieval villages, ancient runes, and gorgeous landscapes, then inevitably die. Horribly!

Forge Your Own Path
Tired of incremental games forcing you to upgrade everything? Let's break that pattern, and the game! Here's some of the things you'll be able to turn yourself into in Flycremental:

  • Mobile Air Fortress: Stack Health, Shields, and build a repair-bot to become nearly indestructible. Laugh in the face of obstacles as you steamroll through them, and enemies!

  • Phantom Racer: Invest in suspension, bounce-boost off the ground, and go for precision steering to zip through the sky at highly impractical (but funny) speeds. Outmaneuver obstacles and ghost past enemies with ease.

  • Arcane Arsenal: Channel raw mana into fireballs, homing rockets, and critical-hit amplifiers. Obliterate everything in your path, turning everyone silly enough to stand in your way into fireworks!

Skill Meets Strategy
Flycremental isn’t just about numbers: the tight flying controls make it a super satisfying game loop to ultimately dominate with insane upgrades. I make it, you break it!

Enemies get more aggressive as they get closer, which is dangerous... for them as well! Bait them into obstacles, projectiles or each other and loot those sweet sweet crystals.

Actual Replayability

  • Procedural Sky Chunks: No two runs are the same. Randomized layouts, destructible scenery, and secret pickups keep you exploring.

  • Short, Satisfying Runs: You're going to die, a lot! And that's okay, because you'll just return to your workshop with more resources to spend.

Strap in, Wizard-pilot: the clouds await!
